title: 3D Ultrasound Breast Imaging
official: 3D Multimodal Ultrasound Imaging for Breast Cancer
summary: The purpose of this research is to study the efficacy of a new ultrasound imaging method for diagnosis of breast mass.

interventions.name: GE Logiq E10 clinical ultrasound scanner

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult women ≥ 18 years of age.
* solid breast lesion and ultrasound guided biopsy (either as part of their clinical care or through participation in other IRB-approved studies)
* lesion size of 3mm or larger

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 18 years of age.
* Lacking capacity to consent
* Pregnant or lactating
* Receiving cancer therapy such as chemotherapy or radiation therapy
